articles.title: The Vampire Lestat releases official trailer — and fans are losing it
articles.summary: The official trailer for "The Vampire Lestat," the rebranded third season of the popular series "Interview With The Vampire," has been released. The show is scheduled to premiere on June 7. This announcement generates significant anticipation among fans of the supernatural drama, marking a key event in the entertainment calendar for its global viewership.

articles.title: Android 17 QPR1 Beta 1 is already here with a sneak peek at September’s Feature Drop
articles.summary: Android 17 QPR1 Beta 1 has been released for Google Pixel 6 models and newer. This beta version provides a preview of the significant changes expected to arrive with Android 17's first major update, scheduled for September. It allows developers and enthusiasts to test new features and contribute to refining the operating system before its official release, ensuring a more stable and feature-rich experience for users.

articles.title: Google Releases Android 17 QPR1 Beta 1 for Pixel
articles.summary: Google has unexpectedly released Android 17 QPR1 Beta 1 for its Pixel smartphone lineup. This update, slated to follow the first stable Android 17 build, offers an early glimpse into new features and improvements. It allows developers and early adopters to test the operating system proactively, identifying and resolving bugs to ensure a more polished official public release.
